beginner.label: Beginner
beginner.message:
You're just getting started—and that's perfectly fine.

The good news is your pronunciation can improve quickly with the right practice.

We'll guide you step by step, focusing on the exact sounds you need most. Just 3-5 minutes a day is enough to start hearing real progress.

elementary.label: Elementary
elementary.message:
You've built a solid foundation, and you're closer than you think.

A few key sounds are holding you back—but they're easy to fix with focused practice. With just a few minutes each day, you'll start sounding clearer and more confident.

intermediate.label: Intermediate
intermediate.message:
You're communicating well, and most of your pronunciation is clear.

Now it's about refining the details that make you sound natural and fluent. We'll help you spot and fix subtle mistakes that most learners miss.
intermediate.cta: Practice today to level up your fluency

upperIntermediate.label: Upper Intermediate
upperIntermediate.message:
You have strong pronunciation and clear speech.

The next step is consistency—making every sentence sound smooth and natural. Daily practice will help you eliminate small slips and build true fluency.
upperIntermediate.cta: Keep your streak going with today's lesson

advanced.label: Advanced
advanced.message:
Your pronunciation is excellent—you sound clear and natural.

To stay at this level, consistent practice is key. Even advanced speakers can lose sharpness without regular use. We'll help you maintain precision and push toward near-native fluency.

terms.sec1Body: By accessing or using the EarlySigns service ("Service"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, do not use the Service.
terms.sec2Body: The Service provides English pronunciation practice and feedback based on international IPA phonetics analysis. It includes free and paid usage tiers, account management, and device-based access rules described in the product.
terms.sec3Body: You agree to provide accurate information, keep your account secure, use the Service lawfully, and not circumvent usage limits or commercially exploit the Service without authorization.
terms.sec4Body: The Service, including its design, content, practice lessons, and AI technology, is owned by EarlySigns. You receive a limited right to use the Service under these terms.
terms.sec5Body: The Service is provided "as is." AI pronunciation feedback is intended for learning and practice purposes and may not be completely error-free in all complex contexts.
terms.sec6Body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from your use of the Service.
terms.sec7Body: We may update these Terms of Use from time to time. Continued use of the Service after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
terms.sec8Body: For questions about these terms, please submit feedback in the app or contact support@earlysigns.app.

privacy.sec1Body: Account information (email), usage data (practice text, recorded audio, check counts, device identifiers), and technical diagnostic data used for authentication and access control.
privacy.sec2Body: We use information to provide and improve the AI pronunciation checker, authenticate sessions, enforce quota limits, process memberships, and comply with legal requirements.
privacy.sec3Body: Recorded voice audio and input text are processed to compute IPA phoneme scores and speech clarity. This data may be retained anonymously to improve speech recognition models.
privacy.sec4Body: We do not sell your personal information. Data is only shared with trusted cloud infrastructure and payment processing partners bound by strict confidentiality.
privacy.sec5Body: We employ reasonable technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, or loss.
privacy.sec6Body: You can view and update your information in the app at any time. You may also request permanent account and data deletion via support@earlysigns.app or the in-app delete account action.
privacy.sec7Body: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Continued use of the Service after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.
